note: Leave url as an empty string until the real address is known. The app then shows Link not set yet. The reviewed CoR app used REPLACE-WITH-… placeholders for these four systems. Use a full https URL when you set one. Do not put personal phone numbers here.

links.name: Tanda
links.blurb: Roster and pay. A roster in Tanda does not override work and rest limits or fitness to drive.

links.name: Logmaster
links.blurb: Electronic work diary. If you are unsure what to enter, check with your manager.

links.name: Intellifleet
links.blurb: Pre-starts. A failed pre-start goes to the General Manager. Do not delete it.

links.name: MiX
links.blurb: Telematics. It can show a problem. It is not a reason to tell a driver to catch up.
